newsitem.title: JAPAN: Asahi Breweries beats Kirin in January shipments.
newsitem.headline: Asahi Breweries beats Kirin in January shipments.

text.p: Asahi Breweries Ltd said on Monday that in January it captured the largest share of the domestic beer market for the first time in 44 years.
For years, Kirin Brewery Co Ltd has been the top beer maker in terms of shipments, industry sources said.
In January, Asahi captured a 38.3 percent domestic share and Kirin a close 37.2 percent among the top-four Japanese beer makers, an Asahi spokesman said.
Sapporo Breweries Ltd took a 19.0 percent share and unlisted Suntory Ltd 5.6 percent, he said.
Asahi obtained the top position due largely to a sharp year-on-year increase in sales of its "Super Dry" beer, the Asahi spokesman said.
"The increase is as a result of our efforts to meet consumer demand for canned draft beer," the spokesman said.
Sales of "Super Dry" rose 42 percent year-on-year in January, he said.
